name: Momentive Technologies
old_description: We partner with scientists, developers and manufacturers who envision a world that’s smarter, more efficient, better connected and more sustainable.
about:
Momentive Technologies is headquartered in Strongsville, Ohio. The company traces its roots back more than 130 years, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated. The business began as a materials innovator and has evolved into a global supplier of advanced quartz, ceramics, and graphite products.

The company manufactures fused quartz, ceramic components, crucibles, heaters, and high‑thermal‑conductivity graphite. Its processes include customizing quartz by dimension, purity, bubble content, and coating, as well as applying ceramic coatings. Momentive operates 10 facilities across Asia, Europe, and North America, employs over 900 people worldwide, and sells into 30 countries.

Its materials serve the silicon semiconductor, compound semiconductor, electronics, aerospace, lighting, and telecommunications industries. Customers include scientists, developers, and manufacturers who require high‑purity quartz for wafer processing, durable ceramics for high‑temperature environments, and graphite for thermal management in electric vehicles and AI hardware.

Momentive differentiates itself as the self‑described global leader in fused quartz, citing exclusive access to one of the purest quartz mines in the United States. The company emphasizes unmatched purity, consistency, and stability, along with a set of guiding principles — determination, precision, responsiveness, trustworthiness, integrity, and intelligent risk‑taking — that shape its approach to custom, scalable solutions.
